midpen-hiking-hounds.title: Halloween & Hiking Hounds
midpen-hiking-hounds.text:
Halloween & Hiking Hounds
 Home 
  
 Events & Activities 
  
 Docent-Led Activities 
  
 Halloween & Hiking Hounds 
Saturday, October 31, 2026
10:30 am - 12:00 pm
 Pulgas Ridge Preserve
Approximate Total Miles
 2.5
Image
 Dogs
Celebrate Halloween with your canine companion on a moderately-paced hike in this dog-friendly preserve. The dogs will enjoy the scents along the Blue Oak, Hassler, Polly Geraci, and Cordilleras trails while their humans learn about the natural surroundings from Docent Naturalists Susan Bernhard and Minh Pham. Costumes are optional. Trick or treat? Dog treats will be provided! All dogs must be on leash. 
Reservations are required and will be accepted on or after October 17 12:00 p.m. (Noon) and close October 30 at 2:00 p.m.
 Where to Meet
Meet at the 
Pulgas Ridge Parking Area
 on Edmonds Rd. From I-280, exit Edgewood Road.  Drive 0.75 miles on Edgewood Rd. toward San Carlos/Redwood City. Turn left (north) on Crestview Drive, then immediately turn left on Edmonds Road. Follow Edmonds Rd. to the preserve parking lot entrance on the right.
 Link to Google Map
